$comment: ADR-009 pinned runtime manifest. Exact tested release combination for the isolated OpenClaw runtime — never 'latest'. Recorded before provisioning per ADR-009 step 1. Integrity values mirror package-lock.json (npm's reproducibility source); provisioning validates pins against the installed tree, never a registry lookup.

@openclaw/gateway-client.role: Gateway WebSocket protocol client (supported external-app path)

@modelcontextprotocol/sdk.role: Gather-owned MCP boundary (Streamable HTTP server + client)

zod.role: MCP tool input schemas (satisfies the SDK's ^3.25 || ^4.0 range)

openclawRuntime.$comment: Host-installed openclaw binary is resolved as an explicit absolute path and verified via --version (OpenClaw x.y.z banner required). No version is pinned here because the binary is host-supplied, not npm-installed; the verified version is recorded in the doctor/provision log, never assumed.

budgets.$comment: C08 release defaults, enforced by src/server/budget.ts. Configurable before running.
